metaDescription: Shopify store for Breakout, a Pakistani western wear brand: a headless Hydrogen storefront for men, women and kids, with video-led pages and wish lists.
summary: Headless Shopify storefront for a western wear brand dressing men, women and kids.
overview: Breakout sells western wear for men, women, boys and girls, from tees, denim and knits to jackets, shawls, perfumes and accessories. We built Breakout's Shopify store as a headless Hydrogen storefront, so the brand's seasonal campaigns can lead with full-screen video while the catalog and checkout stay on Shopify.
challenge: One store has to serve four audiences and a large catalog that changes every season, with sale and new-in edits running side by side. The brand also wanted pages that feel closer to a lookbook than a standard theme allows.
approach: The home page opens on a full-bleed campaign video, then shows tiles for Men, Women, Girls and Boys, each followed by its own campaign image and a product row with quick links for sale, tops, bottoms and accessories. A slide-out menu lists new arrivals, the flat 50% off edit, clothing categories from tees to co-ords, and accessories from shoes to wallets. Collection pages show a product count with a 2, 3 or 4 column grid toggle, quick add buttons and wish list hearts. Product pages put the gallery center stage with a floating panel for price, sale badge, Baadmay pay-in-3, SKU, size guide and size buttons.
outcome: A lookbook-style Shopify storefront where each family member has a clear entry point. Sale prices, sizes and installment options are visible before a shopper adds to cart.

process.title: Headless build
process.body: The storefront runs on Shopify Hydrogen, a React framework, with products, collections, cart and checkout coming from Shopify.

process.title: Home page by audience
process.body: After the campaign video, the page is split into Men, Women, Boy and Girl sections, each with a lifestyle image, a shop now link and a scrolling product row.

process.title: Collections
process.body: Breadcrumbs, a product count and a 2, 3 or 4 column view sit above the grid, and each card has a quick add button and a wish list heart.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: A wide image carousel runs behind a floating panel with sale price, discount badge, Baadmay installments, SKU, size guide, size selector, Add to cart and Buy it now.

whyItMatters: Fashion brands sell with imagery, and a headless storefront lets campaign video and photography lead without giving up Shopify's catalog and checkout.

faqs.q: What platform is the Breakout store built on?
faqs.a: It is a headless Shopify store: the front end runs on Shopify Hydrogen (React), while products, inventory, cart and checkout are managed in Shopify.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a headless Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We build both theme-based and headless Hydrogen Shopify stores, including video-led home pages, wish lists and installment payment options. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
